description: This Java class defines the entity 'TaxRateDescription', which extends 'Description' and is mapped to the 'TAX_RATE_DESCRIPTION' database table. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, references a parent 'TaxRate' entity via a many-to-one relationship, and provides getter and setter methods for that relation.

classes.name: TaxRateDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing the description of a tax rate, mapped to database table 'TAX_RATE_DESCRIPTION'. It extends 'Description' and includes a many-to-one relationship with 'TaxRate'.
